title: Warm chicken, new potato and radish salad

grandparents_cupboard.reason: Everything is a whole food or plain staple: chicken, potatoes, radishes, leaves, mustard, vinegar, oil and herbs.

supermarket.reason: Every ingredient is an everyday Tesco item at a normal price.

basic_kitchen.reason: It needs only a roasting tray, a knife and a board, and nothing harder than roasting and tossing.

works.reason: Halved new potatoes and boneless thighs will both cook through in 35 to 40 minutes at 220°C, and 600g of potatoes, 8 thighs and 200g of leaves suits four, with a balanced mustard dressing made in the tray.

honest_times.reason: Halving the potatoes, slicing the radishes, spring onions and chicken, and snipping the chives fits in 15 minutes, and the 40-minute cook matches the roast.

honest_ingredients.reason: Every listed ingredient and seasoning is used, pepper is covered by 'Season', and nothing unlisted appears in the steps.

seasonal_feel.reason: A warm leafy salad with new potatoes and radishes suits late April, and 200g of leaves forms the body of the dish rather than a garnish.

plain_voice.reason: The steps are short, clear and in plain British English.

hearty_healthy.reason: Chicken, potatoes and plenty of fresh veg make a satisfying, balanced lunch a family would eat again.
